A LITTLE ABOUT YOUR MESSMATE

Good food.
Less guesswork.

An independent student-made companion for the SRMIST hostel mess. Explore the menu, check meal hours and keep your favourites. No account needed.

The details

The menu is transcribed from the supplied SRMIST document dated 19 July 2026. Meal timings come from the original Messmate project and may change; confirm locally with your mess.

Special dishes are limited and depend on seasonal availability. The document lists chicken and paneer biryani on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday, without specifying a meal slot.

Favourites and your veg preference stay in this browser. “Veg only” hides listed meat and egg dishes; it is not an allergen guide. Food photography is illustrative.
